blurb.text: A wine region on limestone hills at the north end of Lisboa, reaching into the Beiras. It was promoted to DOC and absorbed the Alcobaça area as a subregion. Allowed grapes include Fernão Pires, Arinto, Baga, Touriga Nacional and Trincadeira.
